question.text: Cat III AIFs investing in units of other AIFs may undertake leverage not exceeding:

answer.text: 2 times the NAV, excluding value of investment in units of other AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular June 25, 2021, leverage limit = 2x NAV excluding value of investment in other AIFs. The Trap: Other answers mis-state the exclusion. Cross-Exam Context: Important FoF-specific rule.
